summary: Reproduced GLM5 fused MLA corruption when RunAI-marked q_a_proj or kv_a_proj_with_mqa views were retained across reuse of a staging buffer. The loader now takes ownership only for marked tensors before caching them, with a shared RunAI ownership helper. Regression coverage includes both shard arrival orders and an unmarked boundary case.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact reusable staging-buffer reproduction: q-first and kv-first cases both corrupted the earlier cached shard; the unmarked independent-buffer boundary passed. Raw summary: reports/j-86b2d144d98a/failing-before.txt

14 focused tests passed after the fix, covering both GLM5 shard orders, an unmarked boundary, RunAI marking/synchronous consumption, and existing DeepSeek ownership paths. Raw summary: reports/j-86b2d144d98a/passing-after.txt
